_comment: Copy to config.json and fill in. config.json is git-ignored: it is the
one file that differs between your laptop, staging and production, and
it is read at runtime so the same built files run in all three.
On the VPS you do not edit this by hand — deploy/docker-entrypoint.sh
writes config.json from SUPABASE_URL and SUPABASE_ANON_KEY at container
The anon key is a public credential and is meant to ship to browsers.
It grants nothing on its own: every table has row-level security, and
an unauthenticated caller gets zero rows. The service_role key is the
one that must never appear here or anywhere else the browser can read.
_mode: server | demo | auto. auto (the default) uses Supabase when a URL and key are present and falls back to demo otherwise.
_environmentLabel: Shown in the topbar so nobody demos against production by accident. Empty hides the badge.
